On Thu, 29 Jul 2004 09:52:15 +0300, Gabriel Wetangula wrote:

> >Hello,

> >I wish to unsubscribe from distance sampling mail list. Please advice me.

This is the first time we have had this sort of inappropriate posting on the list
for several years -- but in case others have the same question, you can leave the
list or change your subscription settings (for example you can get a "digest" of
all messages posted in a day, rather than each individual message) by browsing to
http://www.jiscmail.ac.uk/lists/distance-sampling.html

If you have any questions about your membership, or other administrative matters,
please DO NOT POST THEM TO THE LIST -- instead send them to the list manager (me),
at distance-sam...@jiscmail.ac.uk

Before you post to the list, please read the list guidelines, which are at
http://www.jiscmail.ac.uk/lists/distance-sampling.html
under "File area for the list"
the file distance.sampling.welcome (it is sent to all new members of the list when
they join).

I have already removed Gabriel from the list, and I hope this is the last time we
get this kind of posting for many more years!

Cheers,

- Len Thomas
